designSystem.styleGuidelines:
## Brand & Style

MANGO POP brings an energetic, sun-drenched, high-summer fruit bar aesthetic directly to Cairo's contemporary culinary scene. The experience centers around the sweet decadence of premium Egyptian mangoes, rendered through an unapologetic pop-art lens with luxurious, crisp execution.

### Personality & Tone
- **Exuberant & Sun-Soaked:** Vibrant, juicy, and expressive without tipping into juvenile chaos.
- **Craft-Obsessed & Fresh:** Communicating peak farm-to-cup quality through clean whites and rich saturated tones.
- **Cairo Cosmopolitan:** A modern urban bilingual spirit that feels natively authentic in both Arabic and English.

### Visual Aesthetic
The design blends **Neo-Pop Memphis vibrancy** with **editorial packaging finesse**:
- **Canvas & Contrast:** Warm cream backgrounds layered with pure white elevated floating cards.
- **Graphic Motifs:** Tumbling rounded-diamond "mango cubes", playful offset sticker badges (tilted at -2° to 3°), oversized outlined poster numbers for indexing, and dotted price leader lines reflecting classic juice parlor heritage transformed into contemporary mobile-first editorial style.

## Layout & Spacing

Since this interface functions as a dedicated mobile QR view-only digital menu, layout optimization prioritizes one-handed vertical thumb scrolling and frictionless glanceability.

### Grid Architecture
- **Mobile Handheld (360px - 430px):** Single-column vertical flow with a max container width of 480px centered on wider viewports. Content margins are fixed at `1rem` (16px) to maximize card real estate.
- **Sticky Sub-Header Navigation:** Horizontally scrollable chunky category rail pinned to the top on scroll with seamless snap alignment.
- **Section Spacing Rhythm:** `space-xl` (36px) separation between major menu categories to give breathing room between flavor profiles.
- **Menu Item Rows:** Packed compactly with `space-sm` (8px) internal gaps and `space-md` (16px) between sequential items.

## Elevation & Depth

Visual hierarchy rejects hyper-realistic skeuomorphism in favor of tactile sticker-like pop-art layering:

- **Surface Base:** Deep matte `#FFF8E7` warm cream foundation.
- **Cards & Floating Panels:** Crisp `#FFFFFF` surfaces paired with a dual-stage warm shadow:
  - Base shadow: `0 4px 16px -2px rgba(114, 67, 171, 0.08)` (subtly tinted with POV Purple).
  - Ambient bounce: `0 2px 4px 0 rgba(247, 148, 29, 0.04)` (subtle mango reflection).
- **Sticker Badges & Emblems:** Floating layers casting a crisp offset drop shadow (`0 4px 0px rgba(42, 22, 64, 0.12)`) evoking tactile vinyl peel-off decals.
- **Outlines:** Selective use of soft 1.5px borders in `rgba(114, 67, 171, 0.12)` on white cards to preserve card definition in harsh sunlight.

## Components

### Chunky Pill Category Chips
- Pinned horizontal scrolling row.
- **Inactive State:** Cream background `#FFF8E7`, bordered with 1.5px solid `rgba(114, 67, 171, 0.15)`, text in `#6F6280`.
- **Active State:** Solid POV Purple `#7243AB` with pure white `#FFFFFF` text and a subtle warm glow shadow.
- Height: 44px for effortless thumb tap targets.

### Menu Item Rows (The Dotted Leader Row)
- Structured layout:
  - **Left / Start:** Item Title in bold `#2A1640`, optional badge (e.g., "Signature", "Fresh Harvest"), followed by ingredients/flavor notes in `#6F6280`.
  - **Middle:** Dotted leader line created via border pattern: `border-bottom: 2px dotted #C2B8D2;` running from the text to the price.
  - **Right / End:** Price in bold `#F7941D` (Mango Orange) with currency denomination (EGP) set in small bold `label-sm`.

### Product Showcase Cards (Featured Items)
- Pure white background with `rounded-xl` corners and 16px internal padding.
- Imagery framed within a soft-tinted circular or squircle container (`#FFF8E7` or light mango wash).
- Overlay badges tilted at `-3deg`:
  - "Mango Bomb" / "Best Seller" / "Cairo Exclusive" in Mango Yellow (`#F9CD18`) with Purple text (`#7243AB`).

### Category Headers with Poster Numbers
- Outlined massive poster digits (e.g., `01`, `02`, `03`) positioned behind or floating beside the section heading.
- Category title in POV Purple `#7243AB`, accompanied by a tiny tumbling Mango Cube glyph (`rotate(45deg)`).

### Size & Customization Pills
- Mini inline pills for sizing options (Small, Regular, Litre Jug).
- Light background `#FFF8E7` with active selection indicated by a solid border in `#F7941D`.

### Floating Order Bar / Store Notice (View-Only Menu)
- Sticky bottom pill banner displaying: *"Order at the counter or wave down your server"* or *"Fresh Batch Just Pressed"*.
- Deep ink `#2A1640` background, Mango Yellow `#F9CD18` typography, and rounded full-radius ends.

## Brand & Style

MANGO POP brings an energetic, sun-drenched, high-summer fruit bar aesthetic directly to Cairo's contemporary culinary scene. The experience centers around the sweet decadence of premium Egyptian mangoes, rendered through an unapologetic pop-art lens with luxurious, crisp execution.

### Personality & Tone
- **Exuberant & Sun-Soaked:** Vibrant, juicy, and expressive without tipping into juvenile chaos.
- **Craft-Obsessed & Fresh:** Communicating peak farm-to-cup quality through clean whites and rich saturated tones.
- **Cairo Cosmopolitan:** A modern urban bilingual spirit that feels natively authentic in both Arabic and English.

### Visual Aesthetic
The design blends **Neo-Pop Memphis vibrancy** with **editorial packaging finesse**:
- **Canvas & Contrast:** Warm cream backgrounds layered with pure white elevated floating cards.
- **Graphic Motifs:** Tumbling rounded-diamond "mango cubes", playful offset sticker badges (tilted at -2° to 3°), oversized outlined poster numbers for indexing, and dotted price leader lines reflecting classic juice parlor heritage transformed into contemporary mobile-first editorial style.

## Colors

The palette is tuned specifically for daylight clarity, high-appetite appeal, and vibrant brand recall.

### Color Hierarchy
- **Canvas Base (`#FFF8E7`):** Warm milk cream that softens high screen contrast under bright Cairo sunlight.
- **Surface Elevation (`#FFFFFF`):** Crisp pure white applied to cards and containers to make fruit colors pop.
- **POV Purple (`#7243AB`):** Primary brand anchor. Applied to dominant headlines, primary buttons, structural accents, and bold graphical strokes.
- **Mango Yellow (`#F9CD18`):** Energy accent, backdrop for special highlights, sticker badges, and key tag callouts.
- **Mango Orange (`#F7941D`):** Secondary brand hue used for price tags, dynamic highlights, CTA accents, and flavor markers.
- **Teal (`#17AE9D`):** Complementary refreshment color for mint, detox, and cooler categories.
- **Coral (`#F2654A`):** Spicy/seasonal highlights, signature badges, and fruit blends.
- **Ink Navy/Purple (`#2A1640`):** High-contrast neutral for readable body copy and solid dark iconography.
- **Muted Lavender Ink (`#6F6280`):** Subtle secondary text, dotted leaders, and structural boundaries.

## Typography

Typography establishes an editorial street-poster attitude with high legibility across dense juice and blend listings.

*(Note: In implementation, utilize **Readex Pro** as the unified typeface across both Latin and Arabic scripts to maintain equal optical presence, rounded geometry, and full Cairo bilingual parity. Epilogue and Space Grotesk guide the typographic hierarchy, scale, and stylistic weights for Latin specifications).*

### Typographic Accents
- **Poster Section Numbers:** Scaled to massive display sizes (`4.5rem`), rendered with an outline stroke (`-webkit-text-stroke: 2px #7243AB; color: transparent;`) sitting tucked behind or beside category titles.
- **Menu Titles:** Bold, heavyweight title casing with tight letter-spacing for punchy visual cadence.
- **Numbers & Prices:** High-visibility tabular digits set in bold weights for rapid scanning across noisy counter and mobile-in-hand contexts.

## Layout & Spacing

Since this interface functions as a dedicated mobile QR view-only digital menu, layout optimization prioritizes one-handed vertical thumb scrolling and frictionless glanceability.

### Grid Architecture
- **Mobile Handheld (360px - 430px):** Single-column vertical flow with a max container width of 480px centered on wider viewports. Content margins are fixed at `1rem` (16px) to maximize card real estate.
- **Sticky Sub-Header Navigation:** Horizontally scrollable chunky category rail pinned to the top on scroll with seamless snap alignment.
- **Section Spacing Rhythm:** `space-xl` (36px) separation between major menu categories to give breathing room between flavor profiles.
- **Menu Item Rows:** Packed compactly with `space-sm` (8px) internal gaps and `space-md` (16px) between sequential items.

## Elevation & Depth

Visual hierarchy rejects hyper-realistic skeuomorphism in favor of tactile sticker-like pop-art layering:

- **Surface Base:** Deep matte `#FFF8E7` warm cream foundation.
- **Cards & Floating Panels:** Crisp `#FFFFFF` surfaces paired with a dual-stage warm shadow:
  - Base shadow: `0 4px 16px -2px rgba(114, 67, 171, 0.08)` (subtly tinted with POV Purple).
  - Ambient bounce: `0 2px 4px 0 rgba(247, 148, 29, 0.04)` (subtle mango reflection).
- **Sticker Badges & Emblems:** Floating layers casting a crisp offset drop shadow (`0 4px 0px rgba(42, 22, 64, 0.12)`) evoking tactile vinyl peel-off decals.
- **Outlines:** Selective use of soft 1.5px borders in `rgba(114, 67, 171, 0.12)` on white cards to preserve card definition in harsh sunlight.

## Shapes

The visual world is defined by high-radius roundedness, soft organic shapes, and iconic custom motifs.

### Shape Hierarchy
- **Pill System (`roundedness: 3`):** Category filter tabs, sizing tags, and interactive chips use full-radius pill silhouettes (9999px).
- **Cards:** Rounded with `rounded-xl` (1.5rem / 24px) corners for a soft, friendly, pebble-like quality.
- **"Mango Cubes" Motif:** Scattered graphic accents shaped as rounded diamonds (`transform: rotate(45deg); border-radius: 8px;`). They appear tumbling down page breaks, anchoring headers, or serving as bullet indicators in sizes ranging from 12px to 28px.
- **Stickers:** Small circular or badge-shaped tags tilted organically at `-2.5deg` or `+3deg` angles on product corners.

## Components

### Chunky Pill Category Chips
- Pinned horizontal scrolling row.
- **Inactive State:** Cream background `#FFF8E7`, bordered with 1.5px solid `rgba(114, 67, 171, 0.15)`, text in `#6F6280`.
- **Active State:** Solid POV Purple `#7243AB` with pure white `#FFFFFF` text and a subtle warm glow shadow.
- Height: 44px for effortless thumb tap targets.

### Menu Item Rows (The Dotted Leader Row)
- Structured layout:
  - **Left / Start:** Item Title in bold `#2A1640`, optional badge (e.g., "Signature", "Fresh Harvest"), followed by ingredients/flavor notes in `#6F6280`.
  - **Middle:** Dotted leader line created via border pattern: `border-bottom: 2px dotted #C2B8D2;` running from the text to the price.
  - **Right / End:** Price in bold `#F7941D` (Mango Orange) with currency denomination (EGP) set in small bold `label-sm`.

### Product Showcase Cards (Featured Items)
- Pure white background with `rounded-xl` corners and 16px internal padding.
- Imagery framed within a soft-tinted circular or squircle container (`#FFF8E7` or light mango wash).
- Overlay badges tilted at `-3deg`:
  - "Mango Bomb" / "Best Seller" / "Cairo Exclusive" in Mango Yellow (`#F9CD18`) with Purple text (`#7243AB`).

### Category Headers with Poster Numbers
- Outlined massive poster digits (e.g., `01`, `02`, `03`) positioned behind or floating beside the section heading.
- Category title in POV Purple `#7243AB`, accompanied by a tiny tumbling Mango Cube glyph (`rotate(45deg)`).

### Size & Customization Pills
- Mini inline pills for sizing options (Small, Regular, Litre Jug).
- Light background `#FFF8E7` with active selection indicated by a solid border in `#F7941D`.

### Floating Order Bar / Store Notice (View-Only Menu)
- Sticky bottom pill banner displaying: *"Order at the counter or wave down your server"* or *"Fresh Batch Just Pressed"*.
- Deep ink `#2A1640` background, Mango Yellow `#F9CD18` typography, and rounded full-radius ends.

Here is the high-fidelity mobile design for **POV Juice Bar (بوف) — 01 Menu, Concept B "POSTER MENU"** (01 Menu - Concept B "POSTER MENU").

### Design Highlights:
- **Printed Poster Aesthetic:** Built on a warm cream `#FFF8E7` background with subtle diamond accents, evoking the tactile feel of an artfully printed, high-energy juice shop wall poster adapted for mobile screens.
- **Brand Hero & Wordmark:** Prominent oversized bilingual wordmark featuring the signature tri-color **P** (POV purple `#7243AB`), **O** (mango yellow `#F9CD18`), **V** (teal `#17AE9D`), accompanied by the custom vector brand mark (the purple cup with tumbling mango cubes) and the Arabic name **بوف** (`lang="ar" dir="rtl"`).
- **Sticky Segmented Navigation:** Horizontal pill category bar with bilingual labels, displaying "Mango Signatures | مانجو بوف المميزة" actively selected in solid POV purple.
- **Poster Blocks with Giant Numbers:** Each menu section features huge outlined typographic numerals (`01`, `02`, `03`, `04`, `05`) in vibrant mango orange with deep purple 800-weight headings.
- **Dotted Leader Line Menu Rows:** Formatted cleanly as traditional poster list rows with English titles on the left, muted Arabic subtitles, crisp dotted leader lines, and bold Egyptian pound pricing (`EGP` / `ج.م`).
- **Playful Sticker Badges & Cut-Out Cups:** Handcrafted tilted stickers highlighting specials (*Best seller | الأكثر طلبًا*, *New | جديد*, *Seasonal | موسمي*), paired with studio-shot cup photography seamlessly overlapping fruit-colored backdrop circles.
- **Tumbling Cube Colour Bands:** High-contrast graphic divider ribbons (yellow, teal, coral) between categories loaded with scattered diamond mango cube motifs.
- **View-Only Architecture:** Completely free of bottom navigation tab bars, cart/bag overlays, or login prompts—perfect for a seamless scan-and-read counter experience in Cairo.

- **Numbers & Prices:** High-visibility tabular digits set in bold weights for rapid scanning across noisy counter and mobile-in-hand contexts.

## Layout & Spacing

Since this interface functions as a dedicated mobile QR view-only digital menu, layout optimization prioritizes one-handed vertical thumb scrolling and frictionless glanceability.

### Grid Architecture
- **Mobile Handheld (360px - 430px):** Single-column vertical flow with a max container width of 480px centered on wider viewports. Content margins are fixed at `1rem` (16px) to maximize card real estate.
- **Sticky Sub-Header Navigation:** Horizontally scrollable chunky category rail pinned to the top on scroll with seamless snap alignment.
- **Section Spacing Rhythm:** `space-xl` (36px) separation between major menu categories to give breathing room between flavor profiles.
- **Menu Item Rows:** Packed compactly with `space-sm` (8px) internal gaps and `space-md` (16px) between sequential items.

## Elevation & Depth

Visual hierarchy rejects hyper-realistic skeuomorphism in favor of tactile sticker-like pop-art layering:

- **Surface Base:** Deep matte `#FFF8E7` warm cream foundation.
- **Cards & Floating Panels:** Crisp `#FFFFFF` surfaces paired with a dual-stage warm shadow:
  - Base shadow: `0 4px 16px -2px rgba(114, 67, 171, 0.08)` (subtly tinted with POV Purple).
  - Ambient bounce: `0 2px 4px 0 rgba(247, 148, 29, 0.04)` (subtle mango reflection).
- **Sticker Badges & Emblems:** Floating layers casting a crisp offset drop shadow (`0 4px 0px rgba(42, 22, 64, 0.12)`) evoking tactile vinyl peel-off decals.
- **Outlines:** Selective use of soft 1.5px borders in `rgba(114, 67, 171, 0.12)` on white cards to preserve card definition in harsh sunlight.

## Shapes

The visual world is defined by high-radius roundedness, soft organic shapes, and iconic custom motifs.

### Shape Hierarchy
- **Pill System (`roundedness: 3`):** Category filter tabs, sizing tags, and interactive chips use full-radius pill silhouettes (9999px).
- **Cards:** Rounded with `rounded-xl` (1.5rem / 24px) corners for a soft, friendly, pebble-like quality.
- **"Mango Cubes" Motif:** Scattered graphic accents shaped as rounded diamonds (`transform: rotate(45deg); border-radius: 8px;`). They appear tumbling down page breaks, anchoring headers, or serving as bullet indicators in sizes ranging from 12px to 28px.
- **Stickers:** Small circular or badge-shaped tags tilted organically at `-2.5deg` or `+3deg` angles on product corners.

## Components

### Chunky Pill Category Chips
- Pinned horizontal scrolling row.
- **Inactive State:** Cream background `#FFF8E7`, bordered with 1.5px solid `rgba(114, 67, 171, 0.15)`, text in `#6F6280`.
- **Active State:** Solid POV Purple `#7243AB` with pure white `#FFFFFF` text and a subtle warm glow shadow.
- Height: 44px for effortless thumb tap targets.

### Menu Item Rows (The Dotted Leader Row)
- Structured layout:
  - **Left / Start:** Item Title in bold `#2A1640`, optional badge (e.g., "Signature", "Fresh Harvest"), followed by ingredients/flavor notes in `#6F6280`.
  - **Middle:** Dotted leader line created via border pattern: `border-bottom: 2px dotted #C2B8D2;` running from the text to the price.
  - **Right / End:** Price in bold `#F7941D` (Mango Orange) with currency denomination (EGP) set in small bold `label-sm`.

### Product Showcase Cards (Featured Items)
- Pure white background with `rounded-xl` corners and 16px internal padding.
- Imagery framed within a soft-tinted circular or squircle container (`#FFF8E7` or light mango wash).
- Overlay badges tilted at `-3deg`:
  - "Mango Bomb" / "Best Seller" / "Cairo Exclusive" in Mango Yellow (`#F9CD18`) with Purple text (`#7243AB`).

### Category Headers with Poster Numbers
- Outlined massive poster digits (e.g., `01`, `02`, `03`) positioned behind or floating beside the section heading.
- Category title in POV Purple `#7243AB`, accompanied by a tiny tumbling Mango Cube glyph (`rotate(45deg)`).

### Size & Customization Pills
- Mini inline pills for sizing options (Small, Regular, Litre Jug).
- Light background `#FFF8E7` with active selection indicated by a solid border in `#F7941D`.

### Floating Order Bar / Store Notice (View-Only Menu)
- Sticky bottom pill banner displaying: *"Order at the counter or wave down your server"* or *"Fresh Batch Just Pressed"*.
- Deep ink `#2A1640` background, Mango Yellow `#F9CD18` typography, and rounded full-radius ends.

Here is the high-fidelity mobile design for **POV Juice Bar (بوف) — 01 Menu, Concept B "POSTER MENU"** (01 Menu - Concept B "POSTER MENU").

### Design Highlights:
- **Printed Poster Aesthetic:** Built on a warm cream `#FFF8E7` background with subtle diamond accents, evoking the tactile feel of an artfully printed, high-energy juice shop wall poster adapted for mobile screens.
- **Brand Hero & Wordmark:** Prominent oversized bilingual wordmark featuring the signature tri-color **P** (POV purple `#7243AB`), **O** (mango yellow `#F9CD18`), **V** (teal `#17AE9D`), accompanied by the custom vector brand mark (the purple cup with tumbling mango cubes) and the Arabic name **بوف** (`lang="ar" dir="rtl"`).
- **Sticky Segmented Navigation:** Horizontal pill category bar with bilingual labels, displaying "Mango Signatures | مانجو بوف المميزة" actively selected in solid POV purple.
- **Poster Blocks with Giant Numbers:** Each menu section features huge outlined typographic numerals (`01`, `02`, `03`, `04`, `05`) in vibrant mango orange with deep purple 800-weight headings.
- **Dotted Leader Line Menu Rows:** Formatted cleanly as traditional poster list rows with English titles on the left, muted Arabic subtitles, crisp dotted leader lines, and bold Egyptian pound pricing (`EGP` / `ج.م`).
- **Playful Sticker Badges & Cut-Out Cups:** Handcrafted tilted stickers highlighting specials (*Best seller | الأكثر طلبًا*, *New | جديد*, *Seasonal | موسمي*), paired with studio-shot cup photography seamlessly overlapping fruit-colored backdrop circles.
- **Tumbling Cube Colour Bands:** High-contrast graphic divider ribbons (yellow, teal, coral) between categories loaded with scattered diamond mango cube motifs.
- **View-Only Architecture:** Completely free of bottom navigation tab bars, cart/bag overlays, or login prompts—perfect for a seamless scan-and-read counter experience in Cairo.
